defaults.parallel_candidate: No known cross-test mutable resource in the reviewed source boundary; validate against a serial baseline before enabling.
defaults.resource_serial: Serialize members sharing each resource key across the applicable scope; unrelated candidates can run concurrently.
defaults.isolated_process: Exactly one selected test in a fresh test process; also obey all checkout resource keys.
defaults.quiet_host: Initial timing-sensitive validation without concurrent test/build load; still obey checkout resource keys. Conservative, not proven inherently serial.

shared_conditions: Do not start any build or test while the currently owned test run is active.
Hold source, game_resources, build configuration and environment stable during comparisons.
Clear export and child-dispatch environment variables in future CHILD launch environments, never mutate the coordinator's environment concurrently.
File resources under CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/target remain shared even with distinct CARGO_TARGET_DIR values.
Source declarations are not runtime test selectors. Reconcile each configuration with its test harness list before running.
Do not treat passing functional playback assertions as evidence of uncontaminated process heap/RSS/timing measurements.

non_harness_jobs.reason: Performance measurement requires a fresh process, stable inputs and no simultaneous build/test load; not included in declaration counts.
Observation scenario measures elapsed wall time and sleeps; reserve an independent performance/observation validation interval.
Fault scenario depends on scheduler progress and real sleeps; preserve its existing execution conditions.

checkout:core-debug-artifacts.scope: all test processes and feature configurations using the same checkout
checkout:core-debug-artifacts.reason: World result transitions export deterministic run_seed/battle_uuid paths; diagnostic helpers also truncate fixed filenames.

process:crossbeam-default-collector.reason: Local recorders still use the default crossbeam epoch collector; a pinned guard can postpone another test's reclamation gate.

process:allocator-ledger.scope: all allocations in one test process
process:allocator-ledger.reason: LIVE_BYTES/PROCESS_LEDGER and playback process windows observe unrelated allocations too.

host:timer-validation.scope: host CPU and IO load during initial comparison
host:timer-validation.reason: Actor tests use real 2-120ms sleeps and scheduler progress; keep their initial validation separate from throughput tests.

rules.reason: World/application/trial helpers can finish deterministic battles and export to shared checkout paths. Broad scope avoids guessing helper call reachability.
Files using application/world/trial objects inherit the potential shared combat trace resource. This does not assert every test writes a trace.
Host fixture/actor/persistence helpers can invoke Core applications. Retain the checkout lock pending narrower reachability review.
run_abnormality_scenario writes a fixed stem derived from the abnormality; battle_showcase and nothing_there share that stem.
Explicit fixed debug-event-log writer; another execution of this test shares the same path.
Collector pins and delayed callbacks can affect other recorders despite per-test recorder construction.
Exact process live-byte equality; source explicitly requires --ignored --test-threads=1. Use a fresh process containing this test only.
execute opens the single process measurement window; preserve the semantics of exported samples even when assertions only compare gameplay.
Calls execute and records process-wide memory samples; isolate the test process.
Calls execute and records process-wide memory samples; isolate the test process.
Keep the small actor suite with real sleeps out of the initial parallel throughput trial. Can narrow later using actual timing evidence.
Reviewed fixture helpers use TempDir or UUID roots. env.rs only resolves its fixed example path. Stronger resource rules still apply.
Allocator tests construct local ledgers. RSS test checks parsing/status variants, not a numerical live-RSS bound.
Child-only Command.env settings; fixtures use unique temporary roots or per-test prefix+PID. Keep exact child dispatch and crash tests intact; stronger checkout locks still apply.
